pieces.Text: You can determine exactly how much damage you wish to inflict on a willing or helpless subject.  Whenever you have a minimum to maximum amount of damage to inflict - such as with a weapon - you can choose the amount of damage you deliver within those limits, including foregoing Strength or other bonuses to damage.  You gain a +4 competence bonus on any use of the Heal skill that involves surgery, or any use of Intimidate that involves inflicting pain.
